## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Bùsīyì guāng púsà suǒshuō jīng* (T484) is a one-fascicle Mahāyāna sūtra translated by [鳩摩羅什](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%B3%A9%E6%91%A9%E7%BE%85%E4%BB%80) Kumārajīva at Cháng'ān. The protagonist is the bodhisattva *Bùsīyì guāng* 不思議光 ("Inconceivable Light"; Sanskrit *Acintyaprabhāsa*).

**Abstract**

This is a short Mahāyāna text on the bodhisattva *Acintyaprabhāsa*'s exposition of the perfections (*pāramitā*) and the bodhisattva path. The translation falls within Kumārajīva's Cháng'ān productivity (402–413 CE).
